response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A8.1"], "rationale": "The claim is for essential purchases due to a luggage delay. The evidence states that the luggage arrived 18 hours late, and the insured had to buy hygiene items and clothing because they had none. Clause A8.1 covers the reimbursement of proven costs for essential hygiene items and clothing when luggage is delayed. Clause A8.3 does not apply because the delay exceeded 12 hours. Clause A11.3 does not apply because the claim is not related to extreme sports."}
